uncited: It builds on [Stripe-based On-the-fly Decoding](5363-stripe-based-on-the-fly-decoding.md) by preparing compressed blocks for on-the-fly GPU reconstruction [Parent].
**Global Basis Learning (Optional):** If a global basis is required, analyze the volume to learn a dictionary $D$.
**Local Transform:** For each block independently, apply a transform to project the block data into a pre-defined basis.
**Quantization:** Quantize the resulting coefficients to reduce precision and entropy.
**Entropy Coding:** Compress the quantized coefficients using entropy coding techniques.
*   **Boundary Handling:** Blocks at the volume boundaries may be smaller than the defined block size.
The method addresses the limitations of global transforms by enabling on-the-fly decoding on GPUs, where blocks are decomposed into parallel stripes [Parent].
